name: project-c-cloud
install: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "python --version; git --version; gh --version; if (Get-Command terraform -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { terraform version } else { Write-Output 'terraform: optional-absent' }; if (Get-Command aws -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { aws --version } else { Write-Output 'aws: optional-absent' }; if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { docker --version } else { Write-Output 'docker: optional-absent' }"
